verdict.description: Semantic label for a measurement; `unknown` represents the non-numeric status case.

label.description: Visible name of the share, shown in the legend.

value.description: Size of the share, in the same unit as `max`. Negative and non-finite values count as 0.

valueLabel.description: Text shown beside the label in the legend, such as `28K`. Defaults to the number.

segments.description:
Splits the filled part of the track into named shares and lists them in a legend beneath it,
such as the instructions, conversation and tool results that make up a context window. The
shares stack from the start of the track in the order given, each a lighter tone of the accent,
so the legend carries the meaning and colour never has to. The reading is their sum, so
`value` is ignored, and threshold regions are not drawn.

label.description: Visible name of the unfilled part, such as `Free`.

valueLabel.description: Text shown beside the label in the legend, such as `124K`. Defaults to what is left of `max`.

remainder.description: With `segments`, adds a last legend line for the unfilled track, such as "Free 124K".

min.description: Lower bound for the range. Defaults to 0.

max.description: Upper bound for the range. Defaults to 100.

low.description: Lower threshold boundary for segmented rendering.

high.description: Upper threshold boundary for segmented rendering.

optimum.description:
Optimal target value. Influences computed state semantics to match native
meter expectations.

size.description: Size token for track height. Default `md`.

ariaValueText.description:
Human-readable text exposed via `aria-valuetext`.
When omitted, `aria-valuetext` is not rendered.
Example: `50% (6 hours remaining)`.

ariaLabel.description:
Accessible name applied directly to the meter element when no visible
label element is present.

ariaLabelledby.description:
Id of a visible element that serves as the accessible name for the meter.
Prefer this when a visible label exists.
